title: WHOOP OAuth integration + provider discovery wiring
description:
Implement WHOOP OAuth integration following `docs/WHOOP.md` and related OAuth provider docs.

Scope driven by the WHOOP doc + our recent audit:
- HealthData must import OAuthProviderModule so `HealthDataService.sync()` can discover connected providers + fetch valid tokens.
- `OAuthProviderService.listConnectedProviders(userId)` is a required API for sync workflows and must be implemented.
- WHOOP callbacks differ per environment; create one WHOOP App per environment so Redirect URIs are correct.

References:
- `docs/WHOOP.md`
- `docs/OAUTH_PROVIDER.md`

features.title: Implement required OAuthProviderService.listConnectedProviders(userId)
features.description:
Add `listConnectedProviders(userId)` to `OAuthProviderService`.

Acceptance criteria:
- Returns `HealthDataProvider[]` (or `OAuthProviderType[]` depending on domain boundary) representing providers the user has actively connected.
- Must be backed by the existing tokens repository (no direct DB access from health-data).
- Excludes providers with no tokens stored and providers that are revoked (if revocation is tracked).
- Unit tests cover at least: no tokens, single provider, multiple providers, revoked/stale handling (as applicable to current schema).

features.title: Wire OAuthProviderModule into HealthDataModule
features.description:
Update Nest module wiring so `HealthDataService` can inject `OAuthProviderService`.

Acceptance criteria:
- `src/health-data/health-data.module.ts` imports `OAuthProviderModule`.
- `HealthDataService` can inject `OAuthProviderService` without circular dependency issues.
- Compile check passes.

features.title: Add WHOOP OAuth handler + register in OAuthProviderModule
features.description:
Implement `WhoopOAuthHandler` (authorization URL, code exchange, token refresh) and register it in `OAUTH_PROVIDER_HANDLERS` map.

Acceptance criteria:
- `IOAuthProviderHandler` implementation exists for WHOOP.
- Handler is registered under provider key `'whoop'` in `src/oauth-provider/oauth-provider.module.ts`.
- `GET /oauth/connect/whoop` returns an authorization URL containing expected query params and scopes.
- `GET /oauth/callback/whoop` exchanges code and persists tokens.
- Refresh flow works via `OAuthProviderService.getValidToken('whoop', userId)`.
- Unit tests cover handler URL building and refresh/exchange happy paths (with provider HTTP mocked).

features.title: Add WHOOP config + environment-specific redirect URI guidance
features.description:
Ensure configuration supports WHOOP OAuth for each environment.

Acceptance criteria:
- `environment.configuration.ts` includes `oauth.providers.whoop` with required fields (clientId, clientSecret, redirectUri, auth/token URLs, scopes).
- Docs and config support 'one WHOOP app per env' by allowing different redirect URIs per env.
- E2E or integration coverage validates config shape is required at startup (or fails fast with clear error).

features.title: Implement HealthDataService.sync() provider discovery + WHOOP sync using OAuth tokens
features.description:
Implement provider-aware health-data sync using OAuth module APIs.

Acceptance criteria:
- `HealthDataService.sync()` calls `OAuthProviderService.listConnectedProviders(userId)`.
- For each connected provider, obtains token via `OAuthProviderService.getValidToken(provider, userId)`.
- WHOOP adapter is invoked to pull + normalize raw timeseries/events and daily summaries into OW formats.
- Endpoint `POST /health-data/sync/me` syncs all connected providers.
- E2E tests cover at least WHOOP happy-path sync (HTTP mocked) and multi-provider iteration semantics.
